system.$description: General-purpose system accent color. Both link and the focus ring point here. The previous value, iOS dark system blue #0A84FF, failed both consumers: as link text it measured 3.70:1 on the flat surface and 1.76:1 on the modal (AA needs 4.5:1), and as the focus ring it cleared 3:1 on only one of the four dark surfaces. Dark's four surfaces are the gray 600-900 rungs, so the same squeeze that calibrated border to 300 applies, but text is stricter: 100 is the darkest rung that clears 4.5:1 on every surface (5.24:1 on modal; 200 fails at 4.11). The hue stays blue; the rung is what the floor forces.

surface.$description: Raised surface (card/panel). Dark: tonal gray ladder.

fg-muted.$description: Secondary text. Calibrated 2026-07-27: gray.400 measured 4.20:1 on the surface plane and 3.17:1 on the raised one, below the 4.5:1 that body text needs (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3). Secondary text is still text. gray.200 clears the floor on the two planes that carry it (background 8.62:1, surface 6.61:1) and reaches 4.98:1 on raised. The modal plane (4.10:1) is the residue documented in color.md — dark surfaces climb to gray.600, and no rung except 50/100 clears the floor there without collapsing the muted/subtle/foreground hierarchy. Expect this text to read visibly brighter than before; that is what the floor costs.

fg-subtle.$description: Supplementary text. Calibrated 2026-07-27: it used to hold gray.500, which is the light theme's value and measured 2.52:1 against the darkest plane — failing everywhere, including the ground. gray.300 clears the floor on background (7.06:1) and surface (5.41:1) and stays a rung below fg-muted so the hierarchy survives.

border.$description: Neutral border, calibrated to the ground plane like the semantic borders. It used to alias gray.700, which equalled the raised surface (1.0:1), and was 1.33:1 on the card surface and 1.73:1 on the flat one. gray.300 clears WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 (3:1) on every dark elevation surface, worst case 3.35:1 on the lightest (modal, gray.600). Dark's staircase does have a rung in the 3:1 zone, so this can stay an alias, unlike light. Provisional (2026-07).

shadow.$description: Elevation shadow color. Black, not gray.900 as in light: dark's own surfaces run from gray.900 up, so a gray.900 shadow lands on a surface it barely differs from — 1.30:1 against gray.800, and 1.45:1 against gray.600 even at half opacity. A shadow has to be darker than what it falls on.

shadow-umbra.$description: The near, hard shadow. Dark draws depth tonally and the shadow only separates what the tonal ladder cannot: the ladder tops out at gray.600, so modal and notification share a surface and a toast would otherwise vanish into the dialog under it. 0.3 black gives a 1.56:1 edge there — legible, and still slight next to light's lift (Art.1, elevation.md §3 'ごく僅か').

shadow-penumbra.$description: The far, soft shadow. Holds roughly light's umbra:penumbra ratio.

scrim.$description: Modal scrim base color (opaque). The veil applies it at ~0.4 opacity via the `scrim` token.

code.$description: コードの構文の色(color.md §10。RFC 0018)。intent でも app でもない三つ目の家族で、閉じた6役だけを持つ。識別子・演算子・区切りは塗らず color.app.foreground のままにする。面は color.app.surface に固定し、明暗どちらでも 4.5:1 を満たす(コードは本文である。WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3)。 暗いテーマは 300 段(app.surface に対し 5.4:1)。400 段は 4.2:1 で床を割る。

comment.$description: 注釈。地に沈ませない(色の役の中で最も控えめだが、本文と同じ 4.5:1 を満たす)。

string.$description: 文字列とその中の逃避。

number.$description: 数値・真偽値・null のような字句の定数。

function.$description: 呼び出しと定義の名前。

type.$description: 型・クラス・組み込みの名前。VS Code の既定テーマが型に teal を当てるのに揃えた。

focus-ring.$description: Global focus ring color. Defaults to app.system; override per theme.

border.$description: The component's outline, for `outlined` (emphasis.md). 300, not an alias of `bg`. `bg` is 500 in dark so white text clears AA on it (color.md), and 500 sits at 2.51:1 against the flat surface, below WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 for a component boundary, and worse on the lighter ones (1.93 / 1.45 / 1.19). Dark's four surfaces span #292F36-#526071; 300 is the darkest rung clearing 3:1 on all four (7.06 / 5.42 / 4.08 / 3.36). Unlike soft-bg (color.md §8), this one has a solution.

dataviz.$description: Chart palette (foundations/dataviz.md §3). Three scales with three different promises: categorical separates series, sequential shows order, diverging shows distance from a middle. checks/dataviz.ts enforces them, including under simulated deuteranopia and protanopia.

1.$description: Categorical rung 1 (brand.400). The first series is the brand colour: one series alone reads as "this product's number", and a consumer who swaps the brand gets a chart that follows.

scrim.$description: Veil behind modal / dialog / drawer. Stacking order is --layer-scrim; this token carries the visual value only (elevation.md §6). Opacity is a seed; 0.4 leans to the revealing side so the user keeps context of what's behind the modal (Art.1, elevation.md §6).
